description: GPT-5.6 Luna's check-and-repair loop at xhigh on gdu (fast interactive disk usage analyzer with a terminal interface, written in Go) with a checker that keeps its session across rounds, where luna-xhigh-gdu-v1's checker starts a fresh one every round; otherwise that loop's prompts, graph, limits, resources, evaluation and prices: 5 loop runs of up to 50 rounds. Compared with luna-xhigh-gdu-v1 through the single GPT-5.6 Sol workers of sol-xhigh-gdu-single: both loops at the workers' mean model cost (bench parity) and their costs to reach the workers' mean score (bench match).

task.adjustments_rationale: The reference moves to a root-owned directory outside the workspace (the task statement points there), so builders cannot overwrite or delete it at the build target's path. This adjustment is general, not specific to the task. The bundled documentation is left as shipped: no task-specific corrections.
